name: FormHug AI
description:
AI Forms for Humans & Agents.

FormHug helps you create forms, surveys, quizzes, registrations, bookings, and assessments directly inside Claude.

Simply describe what you need in natural language. Claude can create new forms, edit existing ones, customize themes, publish forms, collect responses, and review submissions—all without leaving your conversation.

Whether you're organizing an event, collecting customer feedback, building a quiz, or running an assessment, FormHug turns conversations into production-ready forms in minutes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FormHug AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FormHug AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://formhug.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FormHug AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FormHug AI lists 37 MCP tools, including add_fields, commit_rich_text_images, create_folder, create_form, create_webhook, delete_folder, delete_form, delete_webhook, get_entry, get_field_rules, get_form, and get_form_settings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FormHug AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FormHug AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does FormHug AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: FormHug AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FormHug AI is developed by Formagic LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
